'''Yag'Dhul''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="Givin">{{Databank|givin|Givin}}</ref> located in the [[Yag'Dhul system]] in the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]]<ref name="Appendix" /> that was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Givin]] [[species]].<ref name="Givin" /> Its environment was so harsh that their organs were sealed away from the [[atmosphere]] and they could survive for a short while in [[vacuum]].<ref name="Heir to the Jedi">''[[Heir to the Jedi]]''</ref> Yag'Dhul was located at the intersection of the [[Corellian Trade Spine]] and the [[Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="Beginner Game" /> During the [[Separatist Crisis]], it joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Along with [[Sluis Van]], Yag'Dhul made up part of a southern sphere of Separatist worlds, to which [[Count]] [[Dooku]] unsuccessfully attempted to add [[Eriadu]].<ref name="Tarkin" />
